notes.title: August 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Update: AI Assisted Rod Control Mode! 🎉[/h1]

I am excited to announce a brand-new way to play Spinshot Party—perfect for those who want to kick back and enjoy the game without the need for complex controls! 🎮

[h3]⚽ Introducing: [i]AI Assisted[/i] Rod Control Mode! ⚽[/h3]

Now, Spinshot Party can be played even more casually, making it perfect for friends and family who aren’t familiar with gamepads! With our new AI-Assisted mode, players no longer need to manually control the rods. Here’s how it works:
[olist]
[*]At the controller setup, simply press the Y-Button to toggle through the various control modes.
[*]Select [i]AI Assisted[/i] and let the magic happen! 🪄
[/olist]
In this mode, the PC will handle the rod movement for you, so all you need to focus on is kicking the ball with the trigger buttons. 🎯 If you want to make some fine adjustments to the rods, you can still do so using the analog sticks, but it’s totally optional.

[h3]What Does This Mean? 🤔[/h3]
[list]
[*]Even More Casual Fun: Perfect for relaxed gaming sessions.
[*]No More Multitasking: Focus on the fun, not the controls!
[/list]
I hope you enjoy this new mode and can’t wait to hear your feedback. Happy Kicking! ⚽

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741371/b8e44e15ebfd8c6f6d1cf0fd0381d179221311a2.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes For July 2024 Pt.2
notes.content:
Some small convenience things:
[list]
[*]Being Idle for 20s in the main menus will trigger an AI vs AI match just for watching. It will use the current game settings
[*]AI looks less robotic. The rods that are further away from the ball wont get updated as frequent as before.
[*]Hard AI to be slightly less hard. Decreased some values that ware just too inhuman.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For July 2024
notes.content:
You asked for it, and here it is! ⚽

Introducing the new [i]Steady Rod Modes[/i]! Unlike the 1:1 Control mode, the Steady modes do not snap the rod back to the center when you release the analog stick. This mode is now the default setting when you start the game. Here are the new settings available for each player:
[list]
[*]Steady Slow
[*]Steady Med
[*]Steady Fast
[*]Steady 1:1 Control
[/list]
The default setting is [i]Steady Med[/i] with a sensitivity of 6. [i]Steady Slow[/i] has a sensitivity of 3, and [i]Steady Fast[/i] has a sensitivity of 12. For those who like to customize their experience, these values can be tweaked in the USER/settings_user.xml file. 🤓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741371/ea29598783f3a1c8f714ad329f49a16514c80096.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes For Jan 19
notes.content:
[h1]New Feature: AI Opponents[/h1]
- AI has been added to the game
- You can play as Solo or Duo against AI
- Three difficulties which vary in responsiveness and skill
- 4 new achievements to unlock around AI 
- small bug fixes that reduce flickering in the menu
